chunks: Whatever was in it from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate transmitter in the chain.
key_terms.حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ: The narrator to whom this transmission chain ultimately leads.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an expression indicating formal narration of hadith material.
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A narrator in the chain through whom the report is transmitted.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Hudhayfah ibn Mansur in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the precise chain of transmission and preserving the source lineage of the hadith material.
